resultPayload.summary:
Staged into the active scene: no earlier structure rebuild was kept; REMOVED the 1 earlier location layer (stg-1ee930e3-l2), replaced by this build's. Empire State Building, 350 Fifth Avenue, New York (Empire State Building, 350 5th Ave, New York, NY 10118, USA, 14.3 m from the geocoded point) in clay from Google 3D Tiles, extracted 94.0 m around the structure: the remeshed scan. The draft survey read 16 of 16 faces from 16 Street View images (© Google) in 16 call (42.4 s); its materials are photo-inferred hints and its 90 colours are measured from the photo pixels, not used as textures. Holes seen on the outside of the building fell to a hole where it shows: from 12 views, 1.21% through holes: 1.14% showing the inside, 0.07% see-through (limit 1.00%; worst view 3.59% at 225°/0°), at the back faces of FacadeLattice_31 31.97%, relief_m11 16.18%, relief_m34 10.97%. The scan resolves shapes of about 1.1 m (median triangle edge 1.12 m, leaf error 2.0 m); the photo texture resolves about 0.31 m (15 cm texels). Finer detail is photo-inferred. What the remesh changed that the scan did not hold: the ground under the structure is rebuilt (a 1408 m² ground patch) and is not in the scan; rectify and facade flatten moved 3% of its 1,117,245 vertices by 1 cm or more (2% by more than 5 cm; at most 0.69 m); 1,874 vertices of proud blocks were kept as scanned and 1,125 snapped at their own level. Exempt from the vertex floor, as measured geometry: vertex floor: scan-derived layer (1,117,245 vertices, the tiles' own density at leaf error 2.0 m, remeshed). Real textures are ready for l2 (the viewport crossfades from the clay to them on its own), made from no Street View view (a district is textured with the tile photo tile_refine carries onto its remesh; Street View is read for an isolated structure only) and the Google tile photo in 95.4 s: 99.5% tile photo transfer, 0.5% clay of the texels. Photo-derived texture is photo-inferred (labelled per texel); generated PBR is not available, so texels no photo reaches keep the measured palette colour. Built in 565.8 s (resolve 0.5, tiles 1.7, survey 47.4, evidence 113.6, remesh 371.1, ownership 57.4, textures 95.4, textures-late 22.0 s); textures-late from cache.

Views & Materials: put this line in your reply unchanged, it is a pill button the user can click to see the build in studio clay instead of its real textures:
- [Show clay](prompt:Show%20the%20staged%20build%20in%20clay)

stages.source: 16 of 16 faces surveyed in 42.4 s (16 images, 16 vision calls by gemini-4-argon): 141 photo-inferred elements, 90 colours measured from the photos

stages.title: Street View close-ups
stages.source: 7 of 7 Street View images (© Google), kept in memory only, aimed at the structure's facades (no fit was accepted): they texture the remeshed scan

stages.title: Measuring the trees
stages.reason: a single building keeps no surroundings, so its trees are not measured

stages.title: Rebuilt buildings
stages.reason: an isolated structure is rebuilt by its own pipeline

stages.title: Facade grammar
stages.reason: pipeline K rebuilds the facades on their straightened photos instead of reading them as a grammar

stages.title: Measured relief
stages.reason: the measured relief runs on pipeline E's clean massing (SCRATCHBOX_STAGED_PIPELINE=e)

stages.title: Trees
stages.reason: a single building keeps no surroundings, so no trees are planted

stages.title: Ownership vote
stages.source: the vote moved 0.5% of the structure's scan surface (30.8 m² joined, 1555.4 m² left), under the 5% that would replace the geometric isolate; the first isolate and everything built on it stand (the vote's own remesh is not shown)

stages.title: Real textures
stages.source: textured l2 with the tile photo tile_refine carries onto its remesh, de-lit (the shadow and highlight it was captured under lifted/compressed): tile photo transfer 99.5%, clay 0.5%; photo-derived texels are photo-inferred; the twins of later layers follow as they land

stages.title: Real textures of later layers
stages.source: no later layer needed a twin

provenance.label: as-scanned
provenance.method: Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles, leaf LOD, as downloaded

provenance.label: remeshed
provenance.method: tile_refine: hidden shells culled, facades rectified and flattened, cracks closed, photometric relief (inferred, gated)
provenance.note: the ground under the structure is rebuilt (a 1408 m² ground patch) and is not in the scan; rectify and facade flatten moved 3% of its 1,117,245 vertices by 1 cm or more (2% by more than 5 cm; at most 0.69 m); 1,874 vertices of proud blocks were kept as scanned and 1,125 snapped at their own level

provenance.label: photo-inferred
provenance.method: tile_refine's remesh carries the leaf tiles' own photos (UVs into each leaf's image), de-lit (shadowLift 0.6, highlightCompress 0.45; roofs seen from above (467234 texels) highlights only, no shadow lift; 212 of 212 photos); then harmonised (pipeline K): 212 photos matched to 304 side and height-band references, roofs apart (8522 m² of roof seen from above, 9633 m² of hidden up-facing surface left out; 177 roof gains) (mean gain 10%), 99734 shared surface patches levelled: mean patch difference 0.1395 -> 0.1454 (matched) -> 0.1198 (levelled), in log colour

textured.confidenceChannels: R = index into provenance[], G = weight 0..255, B = ladder rung (TEXTURE_LADDER_RUNGS), A = 255 where a stage produced the texel

part.description: holes seen on the outside of the building

degradations.intended: every surface seen from outside closed
degradations.reason: from 12 views, 1.21% through holes: 1.14% showing the inside, 0.07% see-through (limit 1.00%; worst view 3.59% at 225°/0°), at the back faces of FacadeLattice_31 31.97%, relief_m11 16.18%, relief_m34 10.97%

provenanceLegend.label: remeshed
provenanceLegend.description: object ownership: gemini-4-argon outlined the structure in 12 of 12 views of the tile; the vote moved 0.5% of the structure's scan surface (30.8 m² joined, 1555.4 m² left)
